title: 2.3.12 Challenges
description: Pick one (or more) Groups stretch challenges — add a lives counter to Apple Catcher, vary apple sizes for varied points, or implement a `cull()` helper. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a Group
steps.instructions: Declare at least one `new Group()` for whatever the chosen challenge needs (apples, rocks, enemies, pickups).
hints: Re-read 2.3.3 Reading for the Group constructor + defaults pattern.

steps.title: Spawn into the Group
steps.instructions: Use the factory form `new groupName.Sprite(...)` so spawned sprites inherit the group's defaults.
hints: 2.3.3 Reading Topic 2 covers the factory pattern.

steps.title: Use overlaps() somewhere
steps.instructions: Detect a hit, catch, or collect using `.overlaps(...)` — boolean form OR the callback form, your call.
hints: 2.3.8 Reading covers both forms; Apple Catcher (2.3.7) shows the callback form in action.

steps.title: Pick a stretch from content.md
steps.instructions: Implement the lives counter, varied-size apples, or `cull()` method described in content.md. Auto-grader accepts any of the three signals.
hints: content.md describes three challenges with hints; pick whichever matches your interest.

requirements.title: Create a Group
requirements.description: Use new Group() to create at least one Group.

requirements.title: Spawn into a Group
requirements.description: Use the factory form `new groupName.Sprite(...)` to spawn members.

requirements.title: Define a cull() helper
requirements.description: Declare a function named `cull` (function-statement form) — see Challenge 3 in content.md.
